persona_review.selected_persona: Name & Archetype: Milo, 11, a curious child trying a grown-up workspace. The user supplied this persona, so no random replacement was selected. Environment & Constraints: Small laptop and phone-sized screens, keyboard navigation, reduced motion and high contrast. Synthetic scratch Workspace. Picky Obsessions: An obvious first step; plain words; colorful tools; comfortable controls; playful motion that settles so reading stays easy. Tool Attack Plan: jg discovery, source reads, Jev brainstorming and decisions, Jev Browser interactions, Playwright DOM/layout/motion probes, axe scans, screenshots, Rust regression tests, fmt, check and clippy.

iteration.adversarial_review: - [ISS-1.01] [Severity: HIGH] [Location: crates/app/src/routes.rs:home] Tool Evidence: Jev Browser opened the baseline home: five equal tool cards and no recommended first action. Baseline mobile screenshot is evidence/2026-11-03/before-mobile.png. Critique: “What am I supposed to click first?” Acceptance Criterion: A prominent, working first-task action. - [ISS-1.02] [Severity: MEDIUM] [Location: crates/app/src/routes.rs:home] Tool Evidence: Baseline HTML and screenshot show “0 records” and “0 failed Runs available for review”, with no explanation of a Run. Critique: “Records of what? Is a Run something I have to do?” Acceptance Criterion: Concrete count labels, a Run definition and a recovery link when an actual failed job exists. - [ISS-1.03] [Severity: MEDIUM] [Location: crates/app/static/carbon.css] Tool Evidence: Full stylesheet read and baseline browser screenshot: gray canvas, identical white cards and no animation declarations. Critique: “Everything looks the same. iteration.adversarial_review: Final clean pass: zero remaining findings in the tested UI scope. cargo fmt --all -- --check passed. cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked passed. cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings passed. cargo test --workspace --locked: 393 passed, 0 failed, 46 explicitly ignored tests. Published-route regression passed. Playwright Chromium: 17 pages at widths 320, 375, 768, 1024 and 1440 (85 layout checks); axe WCAG A/AA scans at 375 and 1440 (34 scans). Zero findings, console/page errors, failed requests or external requests. Keyboard skip, task creation with Unicode and markup-like text, native help expansion, escaped long owner text, reduced motion, finite decorative motion and forced colors passed. Firefox and WebKit: home, Tasks and Settings mobile layout, reduced motion, keyboard skip, task-entry focus and enabled CSS motion passed. WebKit uses Option-Tab for links, matching its macOS keyboard convention. Cross-document focus assertions wait for fragment navigation to settle. Independent reasoning review accepted the patch after the screenshot and cleanup repairs, resolving Jev’s uncertain test-gap and shared-CSS breadth judgments. Jev verified all four completion claims at 0.94-0.98 confidence; its advisory patch verdict was escalate (safe_to_apply 0.58, composite 0.7689), not an automatic approval. No concrete functional blocker remained. This is evidence for the tested pages and interactions, not a claim about every possible populated record or a validation of live external accounts.
iteration.fixes: None required - all verification checks passed.

persona_review.judgment_record: Jev tools used the configured OpenRouter typesafe/jev-1.14-20261014 model. Fetched research and library source were screened before reuse. Brainstorm judgments: first-task action useful 0.89; fabricated game progress misleading 0.93; constant report-adjacent animation distracting 0.90. Three-step introduction and distinct colors were uncertain at 0.81; these were treated as design hypotheses and checked through rendered inspection. One bounded decision compared CSS mission control, Anime.js mission control and an arcade dashboard. Jev selected CSS mission control at 1.0, with all three requirements supported and no contradicted requirement. The agent retained responsibility for the choice. No product AI behavior changed. An early combined browser question returned 0.62; direct DOM inspection and subsequent atomic questions resolved it. Jev Browser independently reached task capture (done_score 0.92; capture visible p_yes 0.97). The first final-gate submission exceeded its 50,000-character diff cap and was rejected as incomplete context. The corrected submission uses per-file diffs and deterministic test totals rather than asking Jev to sum logs. The resulting uncertainty was escalated once to an independent reasoning reviewer under the Jev skill. That review accepted task-fragment scope, real regression coverage, intentional reversible CSS breadth, motion fallback, escaping and full-card interaction, subject to the repairs above.

persona_review.evidence: Retained under docs/ux/evidence/2026-11-03/: baseline.log, cargo-test.log, cargo-check.log, cargo-clippy.log, browser-checks.log, browser-engines.log, browser-checks.cjs, browser-engines.cjs, before-mobile.png, home-desktop.png and home-mobile.png. Screenshots use synthetic test data. Browser probes ran against a mock-only scratch Workspace on port 5417. Reproduction: npm install --prefix /tmp/chief-ui-tools playwright@1.64.1 @axe-core/playwright@4.14.0; install Playwright browsers; start the binary with PORT=5417 WORKSPACE_DIR=/tmp/chief-ui-preview LLM_PROVIDER=mock. Then set NODE_PATH=/tmp/chief-ui-tools/node_modules and run each retained .cjs file with node. Probes write artifacts to /tmp/chief-ui-research and create synthetic Tasks/preferences in that scratch Workspace. jg discovery reported incomplete results at its request bound; relevant source, templates, stylesheet and tests were inspected directly afterward.
